Meet me @ Nordic Fintech Week

Published on: 21/09/2026. Filed under: general

This week, I’ll be at Nordic Fintech Week in Copenhagen (23 & 24 September). I’m looking forward to meeting new, interesting people. If we’ve just met, or you’re thinking about reaching out for a coffee, this page is for you.

My name is Tom. I’m a product janitor for hire. A hands-on product & GTM leader for scaling, underperforming, or difficult product problems.

I have over 20 years’ experience working across ecommerce, saas, growth, b2b & innovation. I can provide both hands-on and management support.

Getting in touch

  • Connect on LinkedIn
  • Email tomstenson@gmail.com

I can help you:

  • Take an idea from 0 to shipped product.
  • Take a product to market: positioning, pricing, growth.
  • Turnaround underperforming products, teams or initiatives.
  • Address complex / critical initiatives that no-one else can get moving.
  • Help scaling teams ship: mature product ops & structure better ways of working.
  • Cover the gap: sudden exits, parental leave. IC to leadership level.

Let’s get coffee

Mostly, I’d love to hear what you’re building, how the model works, & what’s hard right now.

But if you want stories, I’ve got stories. We could talk about:

  • How I was parachuted into a struggling chatbot team with everything on fire - earned their trust, and rebuilt it from the ground up to halve acquisition costs, and 7x activation.
  • Or how I learnt enough machine learning to lead a team of 10 AI engineers and design how a smartphone could diagnose skin conditions.
  • Or maybe how I convinced a room of Novo executives to bin their product brief, and completely change the way of working.
  • Or if we want to go growth, how I ran growth experiments to treble sign-ups at devops startup Opbeat, or reversed 4 years of sales decline at a domain registrar.
  • Or even if we want to go way back, how I redesigned the domain search box, increasing revenue by 20% overnight and accidentally creating a new industry standard.

I also mentor early-career PM’s pro-bono, so if you’d like a safe-space to chat or nerd out about product - I’d be happy to talk.
